traps: the app has no backend and no database of its own: every load function and form action calls the external REST API https://api.realworld.show/api, a literal in src/lib/api.js; no environment variable, no SDK and no manifest names it
pnpm-workspace.yaml holds only onlyBuiltDependencies (esbuild) and no packages: this is a single pnpm project, not a workspace
all ten dependencies are devDependencies, including svelte, @sveltejs/kit, marked and sanitize-html, which run on the server at request time: the app is bundled at build time

jsconfig.json only extends ./.svelte-kit/tsconfig.json, which svelte-kit sync generates and .gitignore excludes: the $lib alias and the compiler options are in no file of the repository; $lib is a SvelteKit default, and ./$types in the JSDoc comments is generated too
typescript is a devDependency but the repository has no .ts file and no check script: the sources are JavaScript with JSDoc types and Svelte files with plain <script>
$app/state, $app/stores and $app/forms are virtual modules of SvelteKit, not packages or files

route files (+page.svelte, +page.server.js, +layout.server.js, +page.js, +error.svelte) are routes by naming convention; Nav.svelte, Editor.svelte, get_articles.js and the like sit in src/routes without being routes; one unit holds browser code and server code
Node 20 comes from .nvmrc alone: package.json has no engines field although .npmrc sets engine-strict=true; pnpm 10.20.0 comes from packageManager; there is no CI workflow and no Dockerfile
pnpm-lock.yaml (lockfileVersion 9.0) resolves 178 packages; only the ten under importers . are direct
Vercel shows only through @sveltejs/adapter-vercel in svelte.config.js: there is no vercel.json

Ionicons 2.0.1 and Google Fonts are stylesheets loaded from CDNs in src/app.html and are in no manifest; the comment there says the Bootstrap theme comes from a hosted CDN, but static/conduit-theme.css is a hand-trimmed local file (Conduit Minimal CSS v4), project source and not vendored Bootstrap
src/lib/assets/favicon.ico is PNG data with an .ico name; src/lib/assets/conduit-logo.svg is an image imported as an asset
the placeholder avatar is a literal URL on static.productionready.io in src/lib/constants.js; user avatars are URLs returned by the API
the session is a cookie named jwt holding the base64 of the user object returned by the API, decoded in src/hooks.server.js: no auth library and no auth service besides the API itself
languages lists programming and markup languages only; JSON, YAML, Markdown and SVG files are present and not listed
